card.name: Inside split-up long words
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of longer words that are split into several parts, such as PEDI-AT-RIC, MAL-AYS-IA, vin-yl and ado-les-cents. It fires in drug labels and in capitalized place names.

modes.label: Pediatric and adolescent
modes.description: The middle piece of age-group words such as pediatric or adolescents.
modes.example: WARNING: RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION IN PEDI<<AT>>RICS AND SEVERE TISSUE

modes.label: Other long terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of chemical, drug or place names like vinyl, basiliximab, sequelae, Malaysia.

card.plain: It fires partway through long words that the model has broken into pieces, such as pediatric, adolescent or Malaysia.
